title: The Great Uprising of 1857: Timeline & Important Q&A
subject: History
series: ICSE Grade 8 History & Civics Exam Revision
chapter: Chapter 6: The First War of Independence (1857)

sections.heading: Major Causes of the Revolt:
sections.content:
• Political: Doctrine of Lapse introduced by Lord Dalhousie (annexation of Jhansi, Satara, Nagpur).
• Socio-Religious: Interference in customs (Abolition of Sati 1829, Widow Remarriage Act 1856).
• Economic: Ruin of handicrafts, heavy land revenue assessment.
• Military: Unequal pay between Indian and British soldiers, General Service Enlistment Act.

sections.heading: Immediate Cause & Key Centers:
sections.content:
• Introduction of the Enfield rifle using greased cartridges (cow and pig fat).
• Barrackpore: Mangal Pandey mutinies on 29 March 1857.
• Meerut: 10 May 1857 - soldiers march to Delhi.
• Leaders: Bahadur Shah Zafar (Delhi), Rani Lakshmibai (Jhansi), Nana Saheb (Kanpur), Kunwar Singh (Bihar).
